name: job-profile
title: Draft job profile
for_each: select id,code from jobs order by code

sections.title: Grading position
sections.note: Source grades remain separate from local grades. A blank current grade means review is needed.

sections.title: Evidence gaps
sections.sql: select rule,finding,source from v_compliance where job_id=$1

name: panel-record
title: Evaluation panel record
for_each: select id,code from evaluations order by code

sections.title: Factor evidence
sections.sql: select factor,level,rationale,evidence from scores where evaluation_id=$1 order by factor

sections.title: Job basis at evaluation
sections.sql: select job_snapshot->>'name' as job,job_snapshot->>'purpose' as purpose,job_snapshot->>'responsibilities' as responsibilities,framework_snapshot->>'version' as method_version from evaluations where id=$1

name: appeal-record
title: Grading appeal record
for_each: select id,code from appeals order by code

sections.title: Evaluation under review
sections.sql: select e.code,e.grade,e.author,e.reviewer,e.review_note from appeals a join evaluations e on e.id=a.evaluation_id where a.id=$1
